tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i zab chos gsang sgrub skor gsum gyi sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra saṃ ba ra shrī ghraṃ sā dho pā ya nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa myur du sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i thabs/ dpal bde chen ye shes la phyag 'tshal lo// sems bskyed tshad med sngon 'gro bas// chos rnams stong pa nyid du bsgom// stong pa'i ngang las rang bzhin gyis// spyi gtsug yi ge bhrūm̐ dkar las// 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bzhir gyur/ de yi lte ba

padma dang nyi zla'i steng*// hūm̐ dkar dmar bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas// srid gsum gyi sems can bde mchog dkar po'i go 'phang bkod/ 'od zer /tshur 'dus yab dkar yum dmar tu gyur la// bde chen lha mo sku mdog dkar/ g.yas /gri gug thog khrag g.yon bsnams pa kha ḍāṃ ga dang bcas pa bzhi// rtsibs bzhi'i steng du bsam par bya// 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi rtse mor ram̐ bzhi las// ye shes me dpung dkar po 'bar ba yi// gsang ba snyoms 'jug de kho na nyid phyag rgya chen po'i mchod pas// yab yum snyoms 'jug byas pa'i sbyor mtshams nas// byang sems dkar la dmar mdangs chags// chu rgyun gnya' shing tsam rang gi spyi gtsug zug /'khor bzhi gyi lha mo kha ṭwām̐ dang yab yum tshul gyis he ru kar gyur pa dang snyoms 'jug pas/ mdzad/ gsang gnas nas byang sems dkar la dmar mdangs can/ rgyun rnams 'bab// spyi gtsug gcig tu gyur nas ni/ spyi mgrin snying ga ste ba ste/ /gnas bzhir babs pas sdig sgrib dag /'khor lo sgo ro ro myur du 'khor bas nad gdon rnams/ 'khor los /bcad dang rtsibs kyis gtubs dang me phung gis bsregs/ 'khor lo'i /rlung gis rang bzhin med par gtor/ bar bsam/ /chu rgyun 'khor lo me dpung rlung*// de la ma yengs gsang sngags yi ge bdun pa bzlas// dmigs pa gtod na rmi lam 'byongs// longs spyod rdzogs sku rang shar 'byung*// de ni sku yi 'khor lo'o// de nas mgrin par bhrūm̐ dmar las// 'khor lo dmar dang pad nyi yi// steng du hūm̐ dang bam̐ dmar las// 'od 'phros gong bzhin spro bsdu bde mchog dmar po'i go 'phang bya// dbus su bde mchog yab yum ni/ gnyis ka

padma rā ga'i mdog 'dra ba// rus pa rgyan drug thod pa skam po'i dbu rgyan rlon rgyan// gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa'o// phyogs bzhir lha mo gri thod can// mdog dmar kha ṭwām̐ bcas pa'o// rtsibs kyi ram̐ las gong bzhin du/ gsang ba de kho na'i /ye shes me 'bar mchod pas mnyes// gtso 'khor yab yum thams cad kyi sbyor mtshams nas// byang sems dmar pa'i la dkar mdangs chags pa chu rgyun byung*// mgrin pa man chad khengs pa yis// nad gdon sdig sgrib dag par bsam// chu rgyun dmar po 'khor los gtubs bcad me phung gis bsregs rlung*/ gis gtor /snying po yi ge bdun pa bzlas par sngar dang khyad par med// dmar ba khong pa'i nang*/ dmar ba la dkar mdangs chags pa me yi 'obs ltar bsam// gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po'o/ rang gi /thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po ni// snying gar bhrūm̐ sngon bai ḍūr mdog /rno ngar ldan pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi po'i lte bar padma bsam// nyi zla 'jigs byed dus mtshan steng*// hūm̐ dang rdo rje'i spro bsdu las// bde mchog sngon po yum dmar zhing*// drag po'i rang bzhin 'khor bcas bsgom/ bzhi /rtsibs las me yi 'ur sgra thug sgra dang bcas pa phung sngo nag 'bar/ bas phyi ltar na nad gdon bsregs/ yab yum snyoms 'jug 'di nang ltar na mchod pa phul bas thugs rgyud bskul nas// zag med bde ba cher rgyas shing*// hūm̐ drag po'i phaṭa gad mo 'brug stong sgrogs// sbyor mtshams byang sems mthing shun mdog /snying ga man chad khengs pa yis// sems kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dang*// khyad par gdon dang rnams/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang rnams// 'khor los gtub cing me phung bsregs// ye shes rlung gis dengs par bya// byang sems chu rgyun drag po yis// sdig sgrib

nad gdon thams cad thal ba'i ri bo la chu 'bab pa bzhin bkru/ nyon mongs pa gti mug dang tshad pa'i nad zhi ba la// spyi gtsug sku yi 'khor lo bskor/ dkar po ga bur byi chu rgyun dang bcas pa/ /dbang du sdud pa dang 'dod chags dang brang nad la/ /dmar po lcags sreg lta bu zangs zhun gyi rgyun dang bcas pa mgrin pa gsung gi 'khor lo bskor// gdon bgegs zhe sdang bad kan la// snying ga thugs kyi 'khor lo bskor/ chu rgyun sngon po me sngo nag 'bar ba/ /rbod gtong ngan pa bzlog pa la// sa bon hūm̐ las/ 'od zer lcags kyu zhags pa yis/ rnam pa mang po 'phros pas/ gnod byed rbod gtong sogs bkug la 'khor los gtubs// mes bsregs rlung gis gtor bar bya/ /'khor gyi /lha rnams zhal ni phyir bstan la// snying po'i yi ge bdun pa'i rjes su mā ra ya// btags la bzlas pas dam nyams sgrol// sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo la// bsnyen pa de re re la 'bum phrag bdun bdun gyis// sa rnams g.yo zhing zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las rnams 'grub// bcu bzhi'i sa rnams rdzogs byed pa'i/ bde mchog /nye bar sgrub pa 'di la 'bad// mkha' 'gro'i srog snying khyod shangs pa khu ba la gtad/ tshig brgyud las /ma spel tsitta'i pho brang du/ /nyer sgrub 'di dang*/ /rang srol bla ma gces par zungs/ nai gu ma /nga rang gis byin rlob spyi bor sgoms/ gsol ba thob/ /sa bcu lam lnga'i rim rnams la// mos gus stobs kyis bgrod par bya// 'di na gsang sgrub mthar thug mchog /bcom ldan 'das bde mchog sku gsung thugs kyi sgrub thabs/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma nai gu mas mdzad pa rdzogs so// bdag khyung po rnal 'byor pas seng lding 'thug po'i nags gseb tu mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal gdams rnams/

tā la'i lo ma la rjed thor bris nas ga'ur bcangs te lus dang ma bral bar byas so// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /bla ma shangs pa'i phyag rdor gsang sgrub bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ma hā badzra pā ṇa ye/ dpal phyag na rdo rje bsgom par 'dod pas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ byang chub tu sems bskyed/ bdag gis yi dam bsgom par bgyi'o snyam du bsams la phyag rgya chen po la blo bzhag go /de nas skad cig tsam gyis padma dang zla ba/ bgegs kyi rgyal po gzhan gyis mi thub pa dregs pas 'gyel ba'i gdan gyi steng du rang phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig pa mche ba bzhi rab tu gtsigs shing khros pa/ ngag tu hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes sgrogs pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar zhing*/ sdigs mdzub bsgrengs pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs brkyang bskum gyis 'gying pa/ khro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par bsams la/ sems yun ring du bzung ngo*// des skyo na gnas gsum du oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po bkod/ ye shes pa spyan drangs shing bstims la sems bzung ngo*// des skyo na sku las skyes pa'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam gyi tshogs mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus/ yang gdugs pa can dpa' bkong bar bsams la sems bzung ngo*// des skyo na bzlas pa bya ba ni/ snying gar zla ba la hūm̐/ de'i mthar/ oṃ badzra ha li ha na ha na sarba duṣṭān hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bskor ba las 'od zer spro ba dang bsdu bar dmigs te bzlas so// de dag ni lha bsgom pa dang*/ sngags bzlas pas sgrub pa'o// ting nge 'dzin gyi sgrub pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ bsam/ de la sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam lha tshogs kyi byin rlabs bsdus te thim/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar pos lus khyab par bsam/

'dis nus mthu dang gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro// yang lce rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga par gyur pa'i lte bar sngags phreng bkod la bzlas pas bdud rtsi dmar po byung*/ rtsa dang khams thams cad khyab par bsams la bzlas pa bya/ 'dis ngag gi nus pa skyed cing*/ ngag mnan pa sogs zhi bar 'gyur ro// yang snying gar rdo rje sngon po'i lte bar thig le sngon po nyungs kar tsam pa la hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par bsam/ de la yid gtad nas rlung 'ching la sngags yid kyis bzlas pas ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo bye bar 'gyur ro// las sbyor gyi sgrub pa ni/ lha las dngos grub blang bar 'dod na/ rang gi mdun du lha chen tshogs kyi bdag po gus pas bka' nod par bsam/ oṃ bhrūm̐ ga ṇa pa ti swā hā/ zhes pas gnad nas bskul/ la phug dang bcas pa'i gtor ma dus gsum du byin na lha'i dngos grub kyi mtsho brdol bar 'gyur ro// klu la dngos grub blang bar 'dod na/ rang gi mdun rgya mtsho chen po gting zab pa zhig gi nang du mchod rten dkar po chen po zhig bsam/ de'i rtsa bar klu'i rgyal po mchog sbyin pa ro stod mi la smad sbrul du 'khyil pas mchod rten la 'khril ba/ phyag g.yon gter gyi bum bzang bsnams nas mchod rten la 'khyud pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag mthil du a las zla ba/ de'i steng du pam̐ las rin po che'i pad snod yangs shing rgya che bar bsams la nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags brjod pas snod de lha mi'i bcud phun sum tshogs pas gang ba'i phud kyis bla ma dang dkon mchog mchod/ bar du klu nyid kyis gsol/ tha ma bdag la byin pas bar chad thams cad zhi/ tshe dang stobs dang bsod nams phun sum tshogs par bskyed/ bkra shis dang bde legs su gyur par bsam mo// yang na las gang sgrub pa'i kha dog dang mthun pa'am/ las thams cad la sku mdog ljang gur bsgom yang btub bo// 'dis las kyi dngos grub thams cad 'byung ngo*// gnod sbyin las dngos grub blang bar 'dod na/

rang gi mdun du rnam thos sras ljang ser be con dang ne'u le 'dzin pa la 'khor gnod sbyin brgyad kyis bskor bar dmigs la gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkod/ rang 'dra bkug ste bstim/ dbang bskur bas phyag rdor gyi cod pan du bsam/ oṃ be shrā ma ṇā ya bhrūm̐ sarba saddhi pha la puṇya dha ra puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ thun mtshams su kha zas bzang dgu'i gtor ma sbyin/ ye shes pa rten la bcing ba'am/ gshegs su gsol/ de ltar byas pas longs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab pa tshe rabs thams cad du 'byung ngo*// mdor na dpal gsang ba'i bdag po bsgoms pas las thams cad byed do// sa gsum gyi 'byung po thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro// gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rnams bran bzhin du mngags gzhug byed do// ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa skye bar 'gyur ro// dpal phyag na rdo rje'i gsang sgrub man ngag dang bcas pa bla ma shangs pa'i thugs dam mo// shin tu zab bo*// ༈ /rnam 'joms gsang sgrub bzhugs so// na mo gu ru/ rje'i zhal nas/ rmi lam sbyong spel 'di grib la sngar bas rnam 'joms kyi gsang sgrub bla ma shangs pa'i lugs 'di bya dgos gsung*/ de la rang gi lus 'di ye nas bum pa rang chas yin te/ skra dang rna ba bum pa'i kha rgyan/ ske bum pa'i mgrin pa/ gsus pa bum pa'i lto ba/ rdo rje nor bu bum pa'i mchu/ srin zhal bum pa'i zhabs/ rkang pa bum pa'i zhabs stegs yin pas bum pa rang chas yin no// rang gi lto ba'i steng du hūm̐ zhig bsam/ de'i mtha' na phar/ na mo ratna tra yā ya la sogs pa'i gzungs tshar gsum gyis lan gsum bskor bar bsam/ de dang*/ hūm̐ dang gzungs las 'od 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod pa phul/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ dang gzungs gnyis la 'od zer char bzhin bab par bsam zhing*/ gzungs lan gsum lnga/ bdun la sogs pa ci rigs pa brjod pas sngags 'od du zhu ba'i khrus chu de/

gdon 'dul bar 'dod na/ khro chung dpag tu med pa me phung dang bcas par bsgom/ bar chad bsrung bar 'dod na rdo rje phra mo khol bar bsam mo// nangs par snga bar langs te/ rang gi chu phud phar btang ste/ de nas chu khyor ba gsum btung*/ khrus bya/ sdig sgrib nad dang mi gtsang ba la sogs pa sangs kyis dag par bsam/ de ltar byas pas nad rims dang*/ gdon grib thams cad thub bo// khrus chu'i gdams pa shin tu zab pa yin// / ༈ /gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī ma hā kā la na mo/ ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma ni gu ma'i khyad 'phags kyi gdams pa/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gsang sgrub nyams su len par 'dod pas/ tho rangs snga bar langs te/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed par byas nas/ rkang pa gnyis bsnol te tsog pur bya/ lag pa gnyis bsnol te sle sha nya la 'ju/ gru mo gnyis pus mo la bkab/ de nas rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs so// zhes gsungs pa'i don la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag go /des ni bar chad mi 'byung zhing byin rlabs che ba'i dgos pa yod do// de nas dbyibs bum pa'i lus kyi 'khrul 'khor lnga bya'o// snang ba bum pa ni rang gi lus bum pa dngos so// rkang pa zhabs/ ske man chad kha/ rdo rje nor bu mchur bsam/ lar gzugs su snang ba thams cad bum par bsgoms pas chog pa yin gsung*/ dmigs rten bum pa ni/ rang lus bum par bsgom pa'am/ thams cad gzungs kyis khengs par bsams pa'i steng du/ dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog mthing nag zhabs brkyang bskum/ g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub dril bu/ spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ khro bo'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing*/ me phung gi klong na bzhugs par bskyed do// de nas gzungs bzlas pa dang rang gi steng gi lha/ nang gi gzungs thams cad sngags kyi rang sgra dang*/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun dang bcas pa bab par bsams la gzungs bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig gam/

brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ 'jog tsa na steng gi lha bdud rtsir zhu nas rang gi gzungs la thim/ gzungs bdud rtsir zhu bar bsams la/ rang gis khrus bya ba'am/ gzhan la'ang byin/ gzhan gyi gzungs chog tu byed na'ang*/ maṇḍal bum pa bcas la/ bum pa la bdag bskyed bzhin bzlas so// 'jog tsa na rang dang bum pa'i chu gnyis bsres la 'thung ba dang*/ khrus byed du gzhug gsungs so// nyams grib chen po phog pa la/ 'di min pa gzhan gang gis kyang mi sel bar gsungs so// ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma ni gu ma'i khyad 'phags kyi gdams pa rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i gsang sgrub/ chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa'i gsung bzhin bris pa'o// maṅgalaṃ// ༈ /dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i zab chos bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs yan lag dang bcas pa bde chen rnam rol zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid dang*// lhan skyes bde chen zung 'jug pa// bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa yis// dngos grub rgya mtsho'i mchog sbyin mdzod// rten gyi gang zag nges 'byung dang snying rje chen pos rgyud 'byongs shing*/ byin rlabs zab mos smin pa/ dam tshig dang sdom pa'i gnas lhur len pa dag gis dngos grub kyi mchog don du gnyer ba'i blos lam zab mo la 'jug par bya ste/ 'di la gsum/ rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs/ man ngag gi nges pa/ yan lag gzhan bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ gnas dben par bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'dug ste/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa rnams spyi dang mthun par bya/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las 'od gsal gyi rang mdangs rdo rje'i srung ba'i 'khor lo dang gzhal yas khang gi lte bar sna tshogs pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du rang skad cig gis dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa sku mdog sngon po 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ ral pa'i cod pan la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ nor bu dang*/ zla ba phyed pas mtshan cing rus pa'i phyag rgya drug sku la brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi rol pas bzhugs shing gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa'o// de la 'khyud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs thams cad gnon cing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa/ thod skam kyi dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pas yab la 'khril ba/ gnyis ka'ang bde ba chen po'i lang tsho mchog tu rgyas shing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes pas gsal btab nas bzlas pa la 'jug kyang rung*/ spro na/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs pa rnams kyis/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ gsang gnas nas rdo rje'i lam du zhugs shing thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ slar yang rgyun mi chad par 'khor bas bde ba chen po'i ye shes brtan par bsams la/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces ci tsam nus pa bzla/ thun las ldang ba na/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim par mos te gsal stong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhag slar yang rang skad cig gis dpal he ru ka'i skur gyur par bsams la/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs te dge ba bsngo/ smon lam gdab/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug go /gnyis pa man ngag gi nges pa mdo tsam ni/ rang nyid bde mchog lhan skyes su gsal ba'i spyi bor bhrūm̐ las sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar pad nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po dang*/ bam̐ dmar po las 'od zer 'phros/ srid pa gsum po bde ba mchog gi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus pa las 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa sku mdog dkar po la yum phag mo dmar mos 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rgyan cha lugs nyams 'gyur thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ rtsibs bzhir snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang*/ thod pa kha ṭwām̐ ga 'dzin pa dang*/ rtsibs rtser ram̐ dmar pos mtshan pa/ de las ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i drod kyis bskul bas gtso 'khor thams cad bde ba chen po'i mchod pas mnyes/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams dang mkha' gsang nas byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun dpag tu med pa bab/ 'khor lo bzhi'i gnas rnams gang bas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dag slar yang 'khor lo myur du 'khor ba las byung ba'i me rlung gi shugs kyis nad gdon bar chad thams cad bsregs shing gtor/ 'od gsal stong nyid kyi dbyings su thim par bsams la yi ge bdun pa ji tsam nus pa bzla'o// de ltar bsgoms pas gtso bor nyon mongs pa gti mug dang tsha ba'i nad sel/ zhi ba'i las 'grub bo// de bzhin du mgrin par gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po'i lte bar hūm̐ dang bam̐ dmar po las gtso bo yab yum dang*/

'khor rnams sku mdog dmar po gsal btab/ snyoms 'jug gi bdud rtsi dmar po'i rgyun gyis mgrin pa man chad gang bar bsam/ dmigs pa'i khyad par gzhan sngar ltar sbyar ba dang*/ sngags bzlas pas nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang*/ grang ba'i nad zhi/ dbang gi las 'grub bo// snying gar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po la hūm̐ sngon po dang bam̐ dmar po las gtso bo yab sngon po/ yum dmar po/ 'khor rnams sngon por gsal btab/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun sngon pos snying ga man chad gang bar bsams la bzlas pas nyon mongs pa zhe sdang dang*/ bad kan gyi nad zhi/ drag po'i las 'grub bo// khyad par rbod gtong sogs zlog par 'dod na/ snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus dmigs bya rnams 'khor lo'i rtser bkug la/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces drag tu bzlas pas snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi zhal phyir gzigs shing 'khor lo g.yon du 'khor ba'i dbal gyis gnod byed kyi lus dum bur gtub/ mes bsregs/ rlung gis gtor bar bsam mo// bsnyen pa byed na/ thog mar bdag gi rnal 'byor gsal btab nas yi ge bdun pa 'bum phrag bdun bzla ba ni rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa dang*/ de nas 'khor lo gsum po so so'i dmigs pa dang bstun nas yi ge bdun pa 'bum phrag bdun re bzla ba ni las sbyor gyi bsnyen pa ste/ des gnas skabs su phrin las rnam bzhi gang brtsams pa thams cad thogs med du 'grub cing*/ mthar thug mchog gi dngos grub phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes la dbang 'byor ba'i tshul/ bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bdun bdun gyis// sa rnams g.yo zhing las rnams 'grub// bcu bzhi'i sa rnams rdzogs byed pa'i// nye bar sgrub pa 'di la 'bad// ces gsungs so// gsum pa yan lag gi rnal 'byor gzhan bshad pa la gsum/ dbu ma yi ge bdun pa'i man ngag rgyud sde lnga gtso bo bsdus lhan skyes/

thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ rang bde mchog lhan skyes su gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma sngon po yar rtse phra ba spyi gtsug dang*/ mar sna yangs pa bshang lam du zug pa/ de'i nang gi spyi bo'i thad du padma sngon po 'dab ma drug pa'i lte ba la oṃ/ 'dab ma drug pa la hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags kyi phreng bas mtshan pa la yid gtad de cung zad bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis sngags phreng kha dog sngon po dpag tu med pa byung*/ dbu ma'i nang thams cad sngo mer gyis gang ba las 'od zer 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad khengs/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ slar yang 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib rgyu dang bcas pa sbyangs/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang la bkod/ snang grags rtog tshogs thams cad lha sngags ye shes kyi rang bzhin/ rmi lam dang sgyu ma'i rnam pa/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bor bsgoms la bzlas pa ci nus bya/ rjes bsdu rim sogs 'dra'o// 'dis sdig sgrib dang nyams chags 'dag ting nge 'dzin dang mngon par shes pa 'char ba sogs yon tan dpag tu med par gsungs so// gnyis pa rgyud sde lnga gtso bsdus kyi yang snying lhan skyes kyi rnal 'byor ni/ rang 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa gsal ba'i spyi bor hūm̐ las dpal gsang ba 'dus pa de bzhin gshegs pa rdo rje mi bskyod pa 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha lugs/ yid tsam du khro ba rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ yum rang 'dra'i reg rdo rje ma/ mgrin par ro gdan la hrīḥlas ma hā mā yā thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ can yum buddha ḍā ki ni dmar mo rang dang 'dra ba/ snying gar bdud bzhi'i gdan la hūm̐ las dgyes mdzad/ yum bdag med ma gri thod can dang sbyor ba/ lte bar 'jigs byed dus mtshan ma'i gdan la hūm̐ las bde mchog yab yum phag mo dmar mo gri thod can/

de gsum ka'ang he ru ka'i cha byad rdzogs pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs so// 'dus pa bde dgyes rnams rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas rig ma la 'khyud pa/ gsang bar ma he dang gshin rje'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje 'jigs byed ma he'i gdong can gcer bu mtshan ma 'greng ba dur khrod kyi chas dang ldan pa/ yum phag mo dmar mo gnyis ka'ang gri thod 'dzin pa thams cad kyang pad nyi la bzhugs pa'o// gnas gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad lha lnga'i rnam par badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ dbang bskur bas lha thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ dbang lha yab yum snyoms 'jug gi byang sems dkar dmar lce thog tu bzhag oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ye shes phyag rgya dang snyoms par zhugs pas bde chen lhan skyes nyams su myong*/ de nas sems ma bcos pa'i rang ngo la cer re gtad/ oṃ āḥbadzra dhṛk hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭī wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams so sor ji ltar rigs pa dang*/ gtso bor bde mchog gi yi ge bdun pa nyid bzla/ 'di'i khyad par gyi rdzogs rim ni/ 'khor lo lnga'i lha rnams snyoms par zhugs bde ba chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu/ thig le dkar zhing 'tsher ba nyungs 'bru tsam par gyur/ de'i 'od kyis lus gang bar bsams la/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ye shes phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag thun mong gi rdzogs rim chos drug gi rnal 'byor gtso bor byas te bsgom/ mjug gi bya ba bde mchog lhan skyes kyi skabs ltar bya'o// 'di ni dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i zab chos kyi snying po ngo mtshar can no// gsum pa thun mtshams su yi dam dang chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/

ci 'byor pa'i gtor ma a mṛ tas bsang*/ swabhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ kam̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum/ a las thod pa'i nang du hūm̐ bhūm̐ trām̐ ām̐ kham̐ las sha lnga/ bam̐ mām̐ lām̐ pām̐ tām̐ las bdud rtsi lnga 'od du zhu ba las dam tshig gi bdud rtsi la/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bdud rtsi thams cad bkug ste thim pas dam rdzas 'bar ba ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs badzra sa mā dzaḥ ljags las hūm̐ byung rdo rje yi// 'od kyis gsol zhing mnyes par gyur// snying po'i mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ ngam a kā ro sogs btags pa lan gsum sogs kyi gtor ma dang*/ arghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las rab rdzogs pa// dkyil 'khor lnga po thams cad la// kun nas dwang bas phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs kyis phrin las gsol/ rang gi mdun du pad nyi tshogs kyi bdag po'i gdan steng hūm̐ mthing ga'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las ye shes mgon po myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs dbang rdo rje nag po chen po phyag drug gis gri thod/ mgo phreng*/ cang te'u/ tre shrū la/ zhags pa rnams 'dzin cing*/ stag lpags rgyan drug sbrul dang mi mgo'i do shal/ phyag zhabs g.yer kha'i phreng ba can/ dpral bar sindhū ra'i thig le rje btsun ma dang sgrol ma/ der hrīḥspyan ras gzigs kyi ngo bo/ spyi bor mi bskyod pas rgyas btab pa/ rab tu khros pa'i mtshan nyid rdzogs pa/ krig krig zhabs kyi stabs can me phung gi klong na bzhugs pa'i steng na rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ g.yas na dpa' bo dar dang bcas shing*/ g.yon na dpa' mo 'dzum dang bcas pa/ 'khor du dpal ldan re ma tī/

gnod sbyin bzhi/ gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal shing tsandan rkang gcig pa'i drung nas myur mdzad mgon po bka' sdod zhing skyong pho nya thams cad badzra ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra kṣiṃ kṣiṃ nyer gcig gis spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi gsol 'debs dang*/ sgrib sel/ yig brgya dang bshags pa gnad dbab/ dbang sdud/ nus mthu skyed pa dang*/ 'khu ldog zhi ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i bzlas pa 'grub na ci rigs bya/ gtor 'bul tsam la med kyang rung*/ de nas gtor ma byin rlabs byas la/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la kṣīṃ kṣe tra bighnān bi nā ya ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swā hā dang*/ shā sa na lan bdun sogs kyis dbul/ spro na 'khor lo so so'i sngags kyis phul/ arghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ laṅka pū ri sum bsregs shing*// sangs rgyas bstan skyong bdud dpung 'joms// zhal gcig phyag drug nag po che// 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas rnams// sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob kyi// mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad sol// mthun rkyen phrin las yid bzhin sgrubs// dgra bgegs thams cad bsgral ba dang*// dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol// zhes bstod cing phrin las bcol/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag gtor ma bsngo na spyi dang mthun/ mthar yi ge brgya pa dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ gshegs gsol dang brtan bzhugs skabs dang sbyar/ bkra shis brjod/ tshogs mchod mdor bsdus byed na/ gtor bsngos kyi rjes su tshogs kyi yo byad gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlab/ phud bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs dang*/

mgon po 'khor dang bcas par so so'i gtor sngags kyis phul/ bar pa rang nyid lus dkyil gyi lha dang bcas par mchod pa'i bsam pas zhen pa med par longs spyad/ lhag ma byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi utstshi ṭa ba liṃ ta bhakṣe bhyaḥswā hā/ zhes bsngos la phyi rol tu dor/ bsngo smon shis brjod rgya cher bya'o// bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa yi// rnal 'byor snying po yan lag bcas// cung zad phye 'dis khams gsum kun// bde ba che la rol par shog /ces pa'ang rtsa ba'i gzhung le tshan rnams dang*/ grub pa'i slob dpon kun dga' snying po'i gsung rab ltar mdor bsdus snying por dril te rang gzhan rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa dge/ ༈ /dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i gsang sgrub skor gsum gyi byin rlabs bya tshul bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ 'khor lo sdom pa dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag /rdo rje rnam par 'joms dang dbyer med pa'i// khyab bdag bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas gsal bar bya// de la 'dir dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa rnams la gsang sgrub skor lnga'am gsum du grags pa las/ dang po bde mchog gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs bya ba'i tshul la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ maṇḍal/ mu khyud sngon po padma 'dab ma bzhi/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang gu rnams yod pa'i lte bar tshom bu sngon po gcig dgod/ de'i mthar mchod gtor bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob ma la bya ba'o// dang po ni/ slob dpon gyis/ bdag bskyed bde mchog lhan skyes sngon po la bya/ sngags yi ge bdun pa bzla/ de nas mdun gyi maṇḍal bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes rang snang gi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su padma zla nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan la bde mchog lhan skyes sngon po/

phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum phag mo dmar mo la 'khyud pa zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum du bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma bzhi la shar du mkha' 'gro ma mthing ga byang du lā ma ljang gu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo ste/ bzhi ka'ang phyag g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo na kha ṭwām̐ ga bsnams pa/ zhabs brkyang bskum stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min sogs nas bde mchog lha lnga'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim/ mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ oṃ tsakra sambha ra maṇḍa la sa pa ri wā ra'i mthar arghaṃ sogs btags pa'i phyi mchod/ mtshan sngags de'i mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las sogs tshigs bcad kyis bstod/ gtor ma byin rlabs byas la mtshan sngags kyi mthar i daṃ ba liṃ ta sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ bstod pa rnams sngar bzhin/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ de nas mdun bskyed la maṇḍal gsol gdab/ rgyun bshags/ ye shes dbab pa/ mdun bskyed dang bla ma tha mi dad pa de'i gnas gsum du sku gsung thugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga re re bzhugs pa la dmigs nas dbang gi dngos gzhi zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul ba nas bzung*/ dbang bzhi pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin du bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ de nas slob ma gral la 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa la bka' babs pa'i gsang sgrub skor gsum mam/ phyis skyer sgang pa las gsar du nye brgyud du byung ba spyan ras gzigs gsang sgrub dang*/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub gnyis bsnan pa'i gsang sgrub skor lnga zhes yongs su grags pa'i nang tshan/

da lam bde mchog gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs yin/ de la sngon du 'gro ba slob dpon gyi bya ba bdag mdun sgrub cing de la mchod bstod bdag 'jug blang ba rnams song zin nas/ da slob ma la bya ba'i ngo skal du gyur pa la/ thog mar slob dpon bde mchog lhan skyes su gsal ba la byin rlabs kyi sngon 'gro'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dmigs nas maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs gsum/ mdun bskyed bde mchog lha lnga la bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags bya ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ de nas slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung ste/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pa tsam gyis ma dag pa'i phung khams sbyangs te 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang nas skad cig gis bde mchog lhan skyes sngon po/ mi mgo dang rus pa'i rgyan can spyan gsum dmar ba/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum phag mo dmar mo la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pas bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed lha lnga'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ de dang 'dra ba'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ lus sems bde bas khyab par gyur/ yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad kyang 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnam par sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab pa tsam spyan drangs te/

khyed rang rnams kyi lus la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol dang yi ge bdun pa'i mthar/ badzra ā be sha ya aḥ.āḥbatags pa'i sngags brjod/ de ye shes dbab pa yin/ da dngos gzhi'i slad du thug 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang bar zhu/ mdun bskyed dang bla ma rnam pa tha dad la ngo bo tha mi dad pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i gnas gsum na sku gsung thugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs pa la dmigs nas dngos gzhi byin rlabs zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal mdzad par zhu/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rin po ches bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang bar zhu/ khyed rang rnams bde mchog tu gsal ba'i spyi bor bhrūm̐ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bzhi pa rtsibs kyi rtse la ram̐ dmar po rlung gis bskyod bzhin pa/ 'khor lo'i lte bar zla nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan dang bcas pa/ mgrin par bhrūm̐ las byung ba'i 'khor lo dmar po dang*/ snying gar yang bhrūm̐ las byung ba'i 'khor lo sngon po/ de gnyis ka'ang rtsibs bzhi pa/ rtsibs kyi rtse mo la ram̐ dmar po/ lte bar zla nyi 'jigs dus kyi gdan dang bcas pa sngar bzhin gsal btab/ mdun bskyed dang bla ma tha mi dad pa'i spyi bo'i bde mchog la khyed rang gis mos gus byas pas/ de las sku'i bde mchog gi ngo bor gyur pa'i ye ge hūm̐ dkar po dang bam̐ dmar po chad/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i 'khor lo'i lte bar byon pas sku'i bde mchog yab dkar yum dmar ba mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi ka rang dkar mo'i rnam pa can du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi rtse rlung gis bskyod pas ram̐ las me 'od lhag gi byung*/ de phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod par gyur te/ spyi bo'i lha lnga la phul bas/

de dag gi sku las 'od zer 'phros pas/ skyabs yul thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs bsdus/ spyi bo'i lha lnga la thim pas rkyen byas/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi ka'ang yab kyi kha ṭwām̐ ga dang sbyar ba'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po byung*/ khyed rang gi lus thams cad gang bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yi ge bdun pa dang ḍā dril/ yang mdun bskyed dang bla ma tha mi dad pa'i mgrin pa'i bde mchog la khyed rang gis mos gus byas pas/ de las gsung gi bde mchog gi ngo bor gyur pa'i yi ge hūm̐ dang bam̐ dmar po chad/ khyed rang gi mgrin pa'i 'khor lo'i lte bar byon pas/ gsung gi bde mchog yab yum dmar ba mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi ka'ang dmar mo'i rnam pa can/ rtsibs kyi rtse rlung gis bskyod pa'i ram̐ las me 'od lhag gi byung*/ de phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod par gyur te mgrin pa'i lha lnga la phul bas de dag gi sku las 'od zer 'phros pas/ skyabs yul thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs bsdus/ mgrin pa'i lha lnga la thim pas rkyen byas/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi ka'ang*/ yab kyi kha ṭwām̐ ga dang sbyar ba'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun dmar po byung*/ khyed rang gi lus thams cad gang*/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yi ge bdun pa dang ḍā dril/ de bzhin du snying ga'i 'khor lo dang*/ thugs kyi bde mchog gi ngo bor gyur pa'i ye ge hūm̐ sngon po zhes sogs 'don bsgyur gyis/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces sogs 'gre/ yang khyed rang gi gnas gsum na bzhugs pa'i bde mchog lha lnga'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum byung*/ lus thams cad khengs/

mthar spyi bo'i lha lnga mgrin pa'i lha lnga la thim/ de snying ga'i lha lnga la thim/ gnas gsum gyi lte ba'i gdan dang 'khor lo rnams 'khor gyi rnal 'byor ma bzhi la thim/ de yum la thim/ de je phra je chung nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar song ba'i gnas lugs de'i ngang du cung zhig 'jog par zhu/ yi ge bdun pa dang ḍā dril/ de dbang bzhi pa yin no// zhes brda sprad/ de dag gis bde mchog gsang sgrub kyi bka' grub zin pas/ dbang dus su thob pa'i dam sdom bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal sogs spyi ltar bya'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ yig brgyas nongs pa bzod gsol bsdu chog rnams spyi dang 'dra'o// bde mchog gsang sgrub kyi sgos bka' bshad zin to// ༈ /na mo gu ru be/ phyag rdor gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs la sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ maṇḍal padma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su tshom bu sdong po gcig mtha' mchod gtor sogs kyis bskor ba sngar dang 'dra/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la slob dpon gyi las dang*/ slob ma la bya rgyu chos so// dang po skyabs sems sngon du btang nas/ skad cig gis padma dang zla ba bgegs kyi rgyal po a pa rā dzi ta'i gdan gyi steng du rang nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas dang pos rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon dang pos sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba/ 'og ma gnyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lcang lo can nas dpal phyag na rdo rje ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ snying gar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas nad gdon bgegs rigs thams cad tshar bcad par gyur par bsams la/

oṃ badzra ha li dza li ha na ha na sarba duṣṭ+wām̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyer gcig la sogs pa bzla/ de nas mdun gyi dkyil 'khor bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes rang snang gi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su padma dang zla ba sogs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin bya/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ la sogs pas phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na// zhes sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma byin rlabs byas la/ badzra pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang bstod pa gong bzhin/ mthar 'dod gsol bya/ de nas maṇḍal gsol btab nas bzung*/ ye shes dbab pa/ dbang bzhi blang ba/ lha bsgom pa/ sngags kyi bzlas lung gi bar 'og tu slob ma la bya ba bzhin/ slob dpon gyis kyang bdag 'jug gi tshul du bya ba yin no// gnyis pa/ de nas slob ma gral la 'khod pa la sems can thams cad kyi don du zhes sogs sems bskyed brda sprad/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i gsang sgrub skor lnga zhes grags pa'i nang tshan/ da lan 'dir phyag rdor gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs yin/ de la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub zin/ slob ma'i ngo skal du gyur pa la 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul mdzod/ de nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs lan gsum/ mdun bskyed dpal phyag na rdo rje la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pas bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags bya ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ de nas slob dpon phyag rdor du gsal ba la mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed dpal phyag na rdo rje'i thugs rgyud bskul/

de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po dpag tu med pa byung ste/ khyed rang gi lus la phog pa tsam gyis ma dag pa'i phung khams sbyangs te 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang nas skad cig gis padma dang zla ba bgegs kyi rgyal po a pa rā dzi ta'i gdan gyi steng du khyed rang dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas dang pos rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon dang pos sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba/ 'og ma gnyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed dpal phyag na rdo rje'i thugs rgyud bskul bas/ de dang 'dra ba'i phyag na rdo rje'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ lus sems bde bas khyab par gyur/ yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad kyang phyag na rdo rje'i rnam par sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab pa tsam du spyan drangs te/ khyed rang gi lus la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spos rol dang*/ oṃ badzra ha li dza li ha na ha na sarba duṣṭ+wāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra ā be sha ya aḥ.āḥ zhes brjod la ye shes dbab/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi phyag rdor dang bla ma tha mi dad pa la dngos gzhi'i byin rlabs zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul mdzod/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma rin po ches bdag la dbang bzhi pa rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ lan gsum/ de nas thugs 'dun dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gnang bar zhu/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi phyag rdor tha mi dad pa'i dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par spyan drangs te bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ la thim/

de las sku'i byin rlabs kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba nas zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ḍā dril dang*/ oṃ badzra ha li dza li ha na ha na sarba duṣṭ+wām̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ā be sha ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod/ de bzhin du mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar pos gsang dbang gi gsung gi byin rlabs dang*/ thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon pos sher dbang gi thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*/ gnas gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi spro bsdus dbang bzhi pa sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa dang*/ 'don pa bsgyur shes par bya zhing*/ de re re la ḍā dril sngags dang bcas pa gong bzhin bya ba ni 'dra ba nyid do// de ltar dbang bzhi bskur ba la brten nas sgo gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag pas/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis padma dang zla ba'i steng du phyag na rdo rje gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po gsal gdab/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ yig gnyis pa dang sngags phreng 'phros/ zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gi mthar sngags phreng 'khod par bsams la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ badzra ha li dza li ha na ha na sarba duṣṭ+wām̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor ba dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ me tog gi phreng ba de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te spyi bor gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sbyin lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di'i rgyud la dpal phyag na rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig

ces brjod/ de dag gi phyag rdor gsang sgrub kyi bka' phul grub pa yin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs bya/ gsum pa rjes bsdu ba spyi dang 'dra'o// phyag rdor gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs bshad zin to// ༈ /na mo gu ru we/ 'dir rnam 'joms gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs la gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la maṇḍal padma 'dab bzhi'i steng du madzñi'i khar bum pa rgyan ldan bcud kyis gang bar bkod/ mthar mchod gtor dang*/ spro na bgegs gtor bsham/ gnyis pa la/ slob dpon gyi las dang slob ma la bya ba'o// dang po skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgoms nas/ swa bhā bas stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rang nyid rdo rje rnam 'joms sku mdog mthing ga g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang khro bo'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnam 'joms ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐/ de'i mthar sngags phreng gis bskor bar gyur/ gzungs ring ngam/ yang snying*/ na maḥtsaṇḍa badzra kro dhā ya sogs nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs par bzlas/ mdun gyi maṇḍal la dmigs nas bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes rang snang gi gzhal yas khang gi dbus su padma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ de'i steng du hūm̐/ bum pa'i nang du yang pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐/ hūm̐ gnyis ka yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rnam 'joms sku mdog mthing ga zhes pa nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun bskyed dang bum nang gi dam tshig pa so so la gnyis su med par thim/

mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ badzra bi dā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa ni// rdo rje khro bo'i skur ston pa// rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ gtor ma byin rlabs byas la mtshan sngags/ oṃ badzra bi dā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ phyi nang gis mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ de nas bum nang gi lha'i sku lus thams cad las sngags phreng rang sgra sgrogs pa dpag tu med pa 'u ru ru 'phros/ bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med du 'dres par gyur/ na maḥtsaṇḍa sogs kyi yang snying brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzla/ de nas 'jug pa'i maṇḍal nas bzung dbang bzhi pa'i bar bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ slob ma bos la/ phyag dang maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug slob dpon gyis bgegs gtor bsngos nas gtor ma phyi rol tu dor ba dang bgegs bskrad/ 'o sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du chos gsan pa'i kun slong dang kun spyod theg pa chen po'i gzhung lugs dri ma med pa nas 'byung ba ltar gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i gsang sgrub bskor lnga'i nang nas 'dir rnam 'joms gsang sgrub yin/ de la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub zin/ slob ma'i ngo skal du gyur pa la 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul mdzod/ ces brda sprad/ de nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs gsol btab nas bzung ste/ dbang bzhi pa'i bar thams cad la lha sngags brje ba ma gtogs phyag rdor ji lta bzhin byas pas don 'grub bo// de nas na maḥtsaṇḍa badzra sogs brjod cing bum pa thogs la/

bum nang gi lha 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang dbyer med pa des khyed rang rnams kyi lus bkrus pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sangs kyis dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang snying brjod cing gdong la sogs pa 'khru/ mthar hub gsum re 'thung du gzhug de dag gis rnam 'joms gsang sgrub kyi bka' grub pa yin zhing*/ khas blangs pa'i dam tshig bzung ngo snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs dang gtang rag gi maṇḍal phul/ gsum pa rjes bsdu cho ga spyi dang 'dra bar bya'o// 'di'i gsang sgrub bka' rgya ma'i rgyun khyer nyams su len tshul ni/ tho rangs gzhan dang ngag ma 'dres pa'i lto stong mar skyabs sems sngon 'gros/ rang lus ye nas bum pa ni// rang chas grub ste skra rna dag /bum pa'i kha rgyan shing lo nyid// mgul pa bum pa'i mgrin pa'o// gsus pa bum pa'i lto ba ldir// rdo rje nor bu bum pa'i mchu// srin zhal 'og sgo bum pa'i zhabs// rkang pa bum pa'i zhabs stegs so// lhun gyis grub pa'i lte ba'i nang*// pad nyi'i steng du yi ge hūm̐// de mthar gzungs ring tshar gsum gyis// sngags phreng lan gsum bskor bar gyur// hūm̐ dang gzungs las 'od 'phros pas// sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad mchod// de kun byin rlabs 'od zer tshogs// tshur 'dus sngags phreng rnams la thim// gzungs ring bdun lnga gsum gyi bar// rgyas bsdus long skabs bstun la bzla// sngags phreng 'od du zhu ba las// khrus chu gdon la khro chung dang*// bar chad srung la rdo rje'i rdul// phra mo mtshor 'khyil me 'od 'phro// chu phud phar btang bar pa nas// khyor ba gsum btung khrus bya'o// de byas nad rims mtha' dag dang*// grib gdon kun las rgyal ba yi// gsang ba'i khrus chog zab mo 'di// skal ldan re re tsam la'o// zhes pa'i don nyams su blang ngo*// 'di la 'jags pa lung tsam la brten/

byin rlabs 'di bsam sding pa nas brgyud pa yin gsung*/ 'di rmi lam gyi khrid kyi skabs su gnang na 'brel chags te rmi lam 'di grib la sngar bas de sel byed kyi thabs su 'gro/ gsang sgrub bka' lngar byed na/ spyan ras gzigs gsang sgrub dang*/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa nas brgyud pa'i rta mgrin gsang sgrub gnyis bsnan pas lngar 'gro ba yin no// de ltar gsang sgrub skor gsum gyi lag len khrigs chags 'di ni tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po yab sras kyi gsung rgyun tho yig la brten/ dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis lcags 'brug zla ba brgyad pa'i yar tshes bdun gyi nyin 'dar grong chen chos 'khor yang rtse'i bla brang gi dbang khang du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/ zhes pa'i ye ge rtsa bar bkod/ mi gsal ba rnams gsal byed zhabs tog gi tshul du bsgrubs pa'o// smras pa/ mkhas grub brgyud pa'i zhal gyi bum bzang las// 'thon pa'i gsang sgrub skor gyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun// dri med byin rlabs zil mngar ma nyams par// bdag blo'i yol gor 'khyil 'di ngo mtshar rmad// shangs chos ni gu'i skor gzhung bka' phyi ma rnams kyi phyag na bde chen snye ma'i chun po zhes bya ba/ blo gsal ri khrod pas sbyar ba las/ gsang sgrub skor gsum rdzogs so// ༈ /shangs lugs rnam 'joms gsang sgrub kyi sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa bde chen bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bcas bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yis// gzung 'dzin mtshan ma rnam par 'joms// bla ma khro bo'i rgyal po la// btud nas de yi sgrub thabs bshad// 'di la gsum/ bdag gi rnal 'byor/ gzungs kyi sgrub thabs/ las kyi cho ga'o// dang po la gnyis/ thun mong dang*/ khyad par ro// dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/

stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rang nyid rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ khro bo'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing*/ zhabs g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pa'i 'dor stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa ye shes pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gyur/ de la sems rtse gcig tu gtad nas/ gzungs ring tshar gsum sogs kyis thog drangs te/ na maḥtsaṇḍa sogs yang snying gtso bor bzla/ thun 'jog pa na/ snang cha'i lha sku 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim/ slar yang zung 'jug gi skur ldang ste bsngo smon shis brjod bya'o// bsnyen pa byed na/ yang snying 'bum phrag gcig gam/ grub na 'bum phrag bzhi bzla/ bzlas dmigs spyir gong ltar la/ skabs su sngags phreng las 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun dang bcas pa byung*/ lus kyi nang gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sngags kyi nus pa rgyud la zhugs pas las thams cad la thogs pa med par bsam/ 'di rnal 'byor bla med kyi lugs yin pas khrus dang gtsang sbra sogs mi dgos so// gnyis pa khyad par gyi rnal 'byor ni/ tho rangs snga bar langs/ bde ba'i gdan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'dug ste/ rlung ro bsal/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar bya/ de nas lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni/ rkang pa gnyis bsnol te tsog pur 'dug lag gnyis bsnol te sle sha gnyis la 'jus pa'i gru mo gnyis pus mo gnyis kyi steng du dgab/

sems kyi dmigs pa ni/ thog mar rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag de'i ngang las phyi dbyibs kyi lus bai ḍūrya ltar sngo ba'i bum pa/ rkang pa zhabs/ gsus pa lto ba/ mgrin pa yan chad kha/ rdo rje nor bu mchu/ skra sogs bum pa'i rgyan du bsam pa'i nang thams cad gzungs sngags kyi tshogs rang sgra sgrogs pas gang ba'i steng*/ snying ga'i thad tsam du rang sems rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar sgreng ba/ khro bo'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing*/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i 'dor stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhengs pa/ gzungs bzlas pa'i rkyen gyis lha dang sngags las gzungs sngags kyi rang sgra sgrogs shing ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dpag tu med pa babs par bsams la/ gzungs tshar bdun nam/ nyer gcig gam/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ steng gi lha bdud rtsir zhu nas nang gi gzungs la thim/ gzungs kyang bdud rtsir ltem gyis zhu bar bsam/ de yang gdon la khro chung dang*/ srung ba gtso bor byed na rdo rje'i rdul phra rab tu mos te/ chu phud phyir bsal la/ de nas dri chu bar pa khyor ba gsum gyis nye reg bya/ khong du btung khrus bya'o// de ltar byas pas nad gdon grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad srung zhing sel ba'i thabs bla na med pa'o// 'di la dmigs pa'i khyad par gzhan rang lus bum par dag pa dran pa'i tshul gyis gsal btab la/ de'i lte bar pad nyir hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng bkod pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs par bsams la bzlas pa sogs bgyis pas kyang rung ngo*// slob ma thun mong ma yin pa la gsang ba'i khrus chu nyid sbyin pa'am/ de dang gzungs sgrub byas pa'i bum chu sbyar la khrus byed du gzhug par gsungs so// gnyis pa gzungs sgrub kyi cho ga ni/

stegs bu'i dbus su maṇḍal padma 'dab bzhi'i steng du mañdzi'i khar bum pa bcud kyis gang ba dang*/ mdun du zlum gtor/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod bcas bsham/ bdag bskyed gong du thun mong gi skabs ltar gsal btab la bzlas pa cung zad bya/ de nas bum pa yang snying gis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che baiḍūrya'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing*/ nang bdud rtsi'i bcud dang sngags kyi phreng bas gtams pa'i dbus su pad nyi'i lte bar hūm̐ las rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa nas/ gnyis su med par thim/ zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar gsal btab/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ badzra bi dā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod 'bul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa ni// rdo rje khro bo'i skur ston pa// rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ gtor ma/ oṃ badzra bi dā ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/

lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ bum nang gi lha'i sku lus kyi cha thams cad dang*/ sngags kyi phreng ba las sngags phreng rang sgra sgrogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bum pa'i chu la thim pas khro bo'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chur gyur par bsams la/ gzungs ring tshar gsum sogs dang*/ yang snying brgya rtsa sogs bzla'o// thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ bum pa'i lha sngags kyi phreng ba bum chu la thim par bsams la/ rang gzhan gyis bkru zhing btung ba sogs byas pas gsang ba'i khrus kyi skabs su bshad pa lta bu'i phan yon 'byung bar gsungs so// gsum pa las kyi cho ga la lnga las/ dang po slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa byin rlabs kyi cho ga ni/ spyir bdag mdun sgrub tshul gzungs sgrub kyi skabs ltar la/ khyad par dmigs bsal mdun gyi maṇḍal bum pa bcas bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las maṇḍal ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal med khang gi dbus su padma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ de'i steng du hūm̐ bum pa bhrūm̐ las nas/ hūm̐ de gnyis ka yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sogs nas/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas so sor thim pa'i mos pa dang*/ bzlas pa'i bar bya/ mthar lha 'od du mi bzhu bar bzhag maṇḍal nas bzung ste dbang bzhi pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba rnams bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang*/ de nas slob ma rnams mdun du 'khod pa la/ spro na sbyong ba gsum spyi ltar bya/ sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ de la 'dir gangs can grub rigs rgya mtsho'i khyu mchog dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i zab chos gsang sgrub skor gsum du grags pa las/ byin rlabs dang dngos grub mtha' yas pa'i gter du gyur pa/ rig sngags mtha' dag gi las kyi nus pa 'byin byed rdo rje'i rigs kyi khro bo rnam par 'joms pa gsang sgrub kyi bka' zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/

gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du/ bla ma dang rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa tha mi dad pa la skyabs gnas thams cad kyis bskor ba mngon gsum du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs/ dbang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du slob dpon la gus 'dud mdzad pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams la phog pas rnam smin gyi lus sbyangs te 'od gsal stong pa nyid kyi ngang las/ padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa nas/ hūm̐ sngon po slar yang slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs thams cad rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang snying gi mthar/ oṃ badzra ā be sha ya aḥ.āḥ zhes brjod cing spos rol bya/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa dang*/ bla ma tha mi dad pa la dbang gi dngos gzhi'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bla ma rin po ches bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa tha mi dad pa'i dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ la thim/

de las sku'i ngo bor gyur pa'i 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba nas zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang snying mthar/ ā be sha ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod cing spos rol bya/ yang bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa tha mi dad pa'i mgrin pa nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥl thim/ de las gsung gi ngo bor gyur pa'i 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa nas zhugs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags rol bya/ yang bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ de las thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i hūm̐ sngon po dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga nas zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs ka'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags rol bya/ slar yang bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa tha mi dad pa'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum la thim/ de rnams las sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i oṃ āḥhūm̐ dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du zhugs/

dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags rol bya/ des dbang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ mtha' rten gzungs sngags kyi chus byin gyis brlab pa'i slad du/ na maḥtsaṇḍa sogs brjod cing bum pa thogs la/ bum nang gi sngags 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang dbyer med pa des khyed rang rnams kyi lus bkrus shing khong du btung bas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sangs kyis dag nas/ sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ yang snying brjod cing gdong la sogs pa 'khru ba dang*/ mthar hub gsum btung du gzhug mjug gi bya ba dam tshig khas blang ba sogs spyi ltar byas la slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang*/ slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed maṇḍal gyi lha la mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ gnas gsum bsrung*/ bsngo smon shis brjod bya'o// 'di 'jug pa lung tsam la brten byin rlabs 'di bsam sding pa nas brgyud pa yin gsungs/ gnyis pa khrus kyi cho ga ni/ gzungs chog ltar bum pa bsgrub/ rtsa ba'i yi ge las bkru ba tsam las ma bshad kyang*/ rgyas par byed na/ bsgrub bya mdun du 'khod pa la/ 'o khyed rang rnams kyi 'gal rkyen nad gdon grib dang mi gtsang ba'i tshogs zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen smon pa'i legs tshogs spel ba'i slad du khro bo'i rgyal po rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i khrus kyi cho gas rjes su 'dzin pa la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor ba bgegs kyi tshogs rnams la gtor ma byin te sbyong ba gsum byas pa'i mos pa mdzod ces brda sbyar la/ sbyong ba gsum spyi ltar bya/ dngos gzhi bkru byabs srung gsum las/ dang po bkru ba'i slad du/ slob dpon gyis bum pa lha sngags kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ khyed rang rnams la khrus bgyis pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nad gdon bar du gcod pa thams cad sangs kyis dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/

ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs kyi mthar/ gzungs ring dang snying po'i mthar/ sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sarba pā pe bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sarba bighnān bhyaḥ= sarba ro ge bhyaḥ= sarba duṣṭān= sarba gra he bhyaḥ= sarba dzwa re= sarba byā dhi= sarba u pa dra bya= sarba a kā la m-ityu= sarba dur swabni= sarba durni mitte= sarba tsitta ku le bhyaḥshāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod cing bkru/ khar bum chu cung zad 'dzin tu bcug la/ byabs pa'i slad du rma bya'i mdongs kyi thig le'i dbus su zla ba la hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas nad gdon nyer 'tshe bkrus pas ma dag pa'i lhag ma thams cad phyir bsal te rgya mtsho chen por dor ba'i mos pa mdzod/ yang snying gi mthar spel tshig gong bzhin la/ shāntiṃ ku ru'i tshab tu a pa na ya btags pas byabs cing*/ mthar kha nang gi chu khrus gzhong du dor/ grangs gsog na bkru byabs spel la grangs bzung*/ de nas bsrung ba bya ba'i slad du/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje spyi bor bzhag pas/ de las rdo rje'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/ lus la rdo rje'i go bgos te phyin chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs gang gis kyang mi tshugs par srung bar byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ yang snying gi mthar rakṣa rakṣa zhes btags la brjod/ ces bden pa'i stobs brjod pa'i slad du/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gzungs ring thung gang rung mthar/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i nus mthu yis// 'gro ba 'di rnams bdag gis bsrungs zin gyis// 'di la sus kyang gnod par ma byed cig /ces brjod/ slar yang shis par bya ba'i slad du phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang*/

slob dpon lhan cig pas me tog gi char 'bebs shing bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pas kyang mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ shis brjod rgyas bsdus gang rigs mthar/ sbyin pa'i bdag pos gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad bdud dang bar chad spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal te shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod/ gal te glo bur du byed dgos pa'i tshe/ bum chog rgyas par bsgrub pa'i long ma byung na/ gzungs sngags tshar gcig brjod pas skad cig gis lha sngags las byung ba'i bdud rtsir bltas la bkru byabs srung gsum shis brjod bcas byas pas kyang don 'grub bo// gsum pa me yis las sgrub pa ni sbyin sreg gi cho ga ste/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi rim pa rnams gsang ba spyi'i lugs bzhin sbyar du rung ba nyid do// bzhi pa 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga ni/ gzungs kyi dgongs pa grub pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis phye ba'i 'khrul 'khor mtha' yas pa zhig gsungs na'ang*/ 'dir re zhig nyer mkho phyogs gcig tsam brjod na/ gro ga'am shog bu gtsang mar 'khor lo mu khyud drug tu bskor ba'i lte bar hūm̐/ de'i mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pas 'chang ba po la nad gdon bgegs dang bar du gcod pa sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las srungs shig rakṣa rakṣa/ zhes pa lta bu'i spel tshig rgyas bsdus dang*/ spyir btang dmigs bsal gang 'os sbyar/ mu khyud dang po la yang snying spel tshig bcas/ gnyis par rtsibs bcu la hūm̐ bcu mgo phyir bstan pa'i so so'i mdun nas/ 'chang ba po la nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad rakṣa rakṣa zhes pas bskor/ gsum par gzungs ring spel tshig bcas g.yas skor du rim par bkod pa'i yig mgo rgyab dang mjug nang du bri/ bzhi par dbyangs gsal rten snying spel tshig lnga par rdo rje'i phreng ba/

drug pa me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pas bskor/ bri ba'i rdzas skyes pa la gur gum dang*/ bud med la gi waṃ gis bri/ yang na rgya snag gis bris nas rdzas de dag so sor byugs pas kyang khyab/ de nas stegs kyi khar bkod la sbyong khrus rgyas bsdus gang rigs bya/ ye shes kyi rdo rje me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su yig 'bru rnams lha dang*/ ming spel bsgrub bya dngos su bsam/ ye shes pa bstim/ spyan dbye/ mchod bstod/ 'dod gsol/ brtan bzhugs bcas kyi mthar bris pa'i 'khor lo ji lta bar bsams la/ shis brjod rgyas par bya zhing me tog gi char dbab/ gru bzhir lte ba ma nyams par lte ba la tshon skud sna lngas dkris te bsrung bya la khrus chog dang 'brel ba'am/ ma 'brel kyang rung ste mgul du gdags pas rdo rje'i lus su 'gyur/ nad gdon byad phur gang gis kyang mi tshugs/ rigs sngags kyi las thams cad grub cing chud mi 'dza' ba sogs phan yon rgya cher gsungs so// lnga pa rdzas kyi sbyor ba ni/ gu gul nag po/ bong nga 1 nag po/ gla 2 rtsi/ shing 3 kun/ dri chen 4 / shu dag 4 nag po/ sgog skya 5 / sha 6 chen/ mu 7 zi nag po bcas zhib par btags la gsang ba'i khrus chu dang*/ gzungs sgrub byas pa'i bum chus ril bur dril/ rin po che'i snod du blugs/ de'i steng du nyi dkyil la hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng bkod pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas sngags kyi mthu thogs pa med pa'i rang bzhin can gyi ril bur bsam/ gzungs ring thung mang du bzla/ mthar sngags phreng gdan dang bcas pa'i ril bu la thim par bsams la has btab/ rang gi mgul du 'chang zhing tho rangs rgyun gyi rnal 'byor skabs sngags kyis ngar gdags/ de lta bu'i ril bu rang gzhan gyi 'chang ba dang*/ bza' ba dang*/ byug pa dang*/ du bas bdug pa sogs bgyis na mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsrung zhing zhi ba dang*/

dri tshor ba tsam la'ang 'byung po rnams nye mi nus pa dang*/ khyad par nad rims sogs srung ba la mchog tu bsngags so// de rnams ni nye bar mkho ba'i las phran phyag len can 'ga' zhig cung zad bshad pa ste/ gzhan du lha'i rnal 'byor gyi gsal snang brtan cing*/ bsnyen pa mthar phyin pas tsandan dkar po'i chu la mngon par bsngags shing*/ gzungs kyi mthar/ shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā sbyar ba'i khrus bgyis pas nad dang gnod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ dri bzang po dang dūrba sbyar ba'i chu/ puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ gyi spel tshig can gyis rgyas pa dang*/ tsandan dmar po'i khrus chab dang*/ wā shaṃ ku ru hoḥs dbang dang*/ yungs kar gyi chu dang*/ mā ra ya phaṭa kyis drag po'i las 'grub par gsungs shing*/ so sor dmigs bsal yod na las sngags kyi gong du bcug ste/ dper na mig gi nad zhi ba la/ sbyin pa'i bdag po 'di zhes bgyi ba'i mig gi nad thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa lta bu'o// des mtshon te rig sngags kyi mthu thogs pa med par byed pa la sogs pa'i las kyi cho ga nyi shu dang*/ sdig pa thams cad zhi bar byed pa la sogs pa'i las bcu dgu phran dang bcas sogs gtso bor me dang khrus dang*/ 'khrul 'khor gsum gyi sgo nas sgrub pa'i thabs ji snyed cig gsungs pa rnams kyang bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa'i ci rigs pa bsgrub du rung la/ ji tsam du ji skad bshad pa'i las thams cad gong gi khrus chog dang*/ 'khrul 'khor dag la spel tshig sbyar ba tsam gyis kyang rab tu 'grub pa yin no// rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrub thabs dang*// man ngag bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'dis// lus can yid kyi dri sbyangs nas// phan bde'i ngal 'tsho bsten gyur cig /ces pa'ang bla ma shangs pa'i zab chos gsang sgrub rtsa ba'i yi ge le tshan dang*/ gser gling pa'i gsal byed sogs lugs 'di la tshad mar gyur pa'i gzhung rnams gtso bor bzung*/

rigs mthun gyi cho ga 'ga' zhig lhan thabs kyi tshul du sbyar te/ bya bral ba mang thos 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rang gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pas bris pa sarba karma su siddhi rastu// ༈ /gsang sgrub skor gsum gyi brgyud 'debs bde chen char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang ni gu ma// khyung po rnal 'byor rin chen brtson 'grus dang*// chos kyi seṅge sangs rgyas gnyan ston zhabs// sangs rgyas ston pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// gtsang ma shangs ston mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum// mnyam med byams pa dpal dang blo gros dpal// kun dga' dpal bzang kun mkhyen chos rgyal dpal// tshul khrims rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// mkhyen rab chos rje kun spangs chen po dang*// tshar chen rdo rje 'chang dbang mkhyen brtse'i zhabs// dbang phyug rab brtan ngag dbang chos grags dpal// ngag dbang rnam rgyal rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bsod nams chos 'phel legs pa'i 'byung gnas dang*// bsod nams dpal bzang chos nyid ye shes zhabs// ye shes rgyal mchog yongs 'dzin blo gros mtshan// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// snang ba'i dngos kun sgyu ma'i lha skur shar// sgrar grags bde chen nā da'i dbyings su smin// rtog tshogs 'od gsal chen por 'byams klas pas// mchog thun grub pa rgya mtsho'i mthar son shog /ces pa'ang 'jam mgon sa skya pa ngag dbang rdo rje rin chen las chos tshul 'di rnams kyi bka' drin thob pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa dge legs mchog tu gyur cig// /sarba dā ka lyā ṇaṃ siddhi rastu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o//
